LIKE, IN, BETWEEN – searching with a pattern, a list and a range
Oft kennst du nur einen Teil: Der Titel: Often you only know part of it: the title has something to do with “Nacht”. Or you have a list: rock or indie. Or a range: songs from 2019 to 2021. With LIKE, IN and BETWEEN this is short and safe. Every search box in an app works like this – you type a few letters, and the database searches with LIKE.
A template for text with gaps, e.g. “starts with S”.
